name: Platform Deliverables
description: Clients open My projects, choose one of their projects, and open Resources at /platform/projects/:id/deliverables. The compatibility route /platform/deliverables redirects to /platform/projects. Admin uploads project resources with version history. The library displays designs, documents, credentials, APKs, contracts, amendments and legal annexes. Clients download the exact current or previous file through the authenticated Platform API. A denied or interrupted download shows its explanation in the detail; pending downloads disable duplicate requests.
